# Importing PlantUML

[Español](../es/import/plantuml.md)

<!-- Generated by `pnpm import:docs` from packages/import/src/coverage.ts; do not edit. -->

Written against PlantUML 1.2025 and C4-PlantUML 2. `meltemi-diagrams import` and the VS Code commands report every
construct that is not mapped exactly: **approximated** constructs keep their meaning with a
different drawing; **dropped** ones are left out. An import that drops an essential construct
(an element, a relation, a message, an entity or a line it cannot read) is `partial`.

## Preprocessor

| Source | Meltemi | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `!define NAME value`, `!define NAME(a, b) body`, `##` | expanded | mapped |  |
| `!definelong NAME(a) … !enddefinelong`, `!undef` | expanded | mapped |  |
| `!$x = v`, `!$x ?= v`, `!global`, `!local`, `$x` in lines | substituted | mapped |  |
| `!procedure`, `!unquoted procedure`, defaults, keyword arguments | expanded | mapped |  |
| `!function … !return … !endfunction`, one-line `!function $f($a) !return …` | evaluated | mapped |  |
| `!if`, `!elseif`, `!else`, `!endif`, `!ifdef`, `!ifndef` | the selected lines | mapped |  |
| `!while … !endwhile`, `!foreach $x in [ … ] … !endfor` | the repeated lines | mapped | At most 1000 passes. |
| `%strlen`, `%substr`, `%strpos`, `%upper`, `%lower`, `%string`, `%intval`, `%boolval`, `%true`, `%false`, `%not`, `%newline`, `%chr`, `%ord`, `%mod`, `%dec2hex`, `%hex2dec`, `%variable_exists`, `%function_exists`, `%get_variable_value`, `%set_variable_value`, `%call_user_func`, `%size`, `%splitstr`, `%str2json`, `%json_key_exists` | evaluated | mapped |  |
| `%date`, `%now`, `%random`, `%getenv`, `%filename`, `%dirpath`, `%version`, colour functions | stable values | approximated | Imports are deterministic: dates and environment are empty. |
| `!assert`, `!log`, `!dump_memory` | checked or ignored | mapped |  |
| `!include path`, `!include_once`, `!include_many`, `!includesub path!ID`, `!include path!n` | the file's lines | mapped | Relative to the including file, inside the imported folder or project. |
| `!include <C4/C4_Container>` and the C4-PlantUML files by URL | the C4 level | mapped | Recognised, never read. |
| `!include <aws/…>` and other standard libraries | — | dropped | Their macros are not imported. |
| `!includeurl`, `!include https://…`, absolute paths, paths outside the folder, missing files, `!import` | — | dropped | `import.include`, essential: the importer never fetches files. |
| errors, more than 100 nested expansions or 100 000 lines | — | dropped | `import.preprocessor`, essential. |
| `!theme` | — | dropped |  |
| `!pragma` | — | dropped |  |
